Name: FS - Deltarune Tenna Head  And Outfit
Author: casualratmandoug
Description:
[center]﻿[img]https://i.imgur.com/mtB8Xqs.png[/img]﻿[/center][center]HEY YOU! YES, YOU! HAVE YOU EVER WANTED TO BE A GAME SHOW HOST? NO? WELL YOU SURE CAN NOW AT THE SWEET PRICE OF [Free]!

I got bored one day and wanted to play stardew valley, but I missed the tv too much and thus this mod was born. Miss TV too? Well here's a simple solution!
I'm going to be honest here this is my first time doing any kind of modding and I have NO idea what I'm doing here. No really this code is made up of determination and duct tape, toby fox style. If something bugs out, I probably won't know how to fix it and I'm sorry for that

[img]https://i.imgur.com/dy9D9ei.png[/img]﻿
NOW COMES WITH A DOUBLE FEATURE! THAT'S RIGHT, BABY!

Not only do you get a Tenna head, but his entire outfit (with and WITHOUT his signature tie) too! Comes with ALL the features (special head sprites for eating, rain, passing out, and low HP)! NOW THAT'S WHAT I CALL A BARGAIN!

BONUS! Optional file to match the skintone of Tenna! The way the default white skin wasn't lining up bothered me, so I decided to do something about it. THIS DEAL CAN'T GET ANY SWEETER!

[/center][center][size=1]known issues:
the head may get stuck on the static frame on a new day. I have no idea why this happens and it stopped occurring a few hours later (in real time) without me making any fixes so god knows whats happening here. If it comes back, the solution I've found is to manually refresh the mod with fs_reload. yes this is annoying. no i dont know how to fix it sorry in advanced
there's a few stray pixels if you look really closely but i can't remove those since it's the farmer's bald head sprite but this really shouldn't make too much of a difference
[/size]
[/center][center][img]https://i.imgur.com/ZYSY32t.png[/img]﻿﻿
